subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed subagent startup failures be reported through the existing accepted-then-async run path with a terminal startup failure state, or should `sessions_spawn` preflight sandbox startup before returning accepted?
rationale: Both shapes could address the user-visible hang, but the choice affects lifecycle events, registry state, gateway wait behavior, and the overlapping #58776 startup-silence contract.

options.title: Terminalize async startup failure
options.body: Keep the accepted async spawn contract, but emit/log a typed startup failure and prove registry/session UI callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

options.title: Preflight sandbox before accept
options.body: Move enough sandbox startup validation ahead of the accepted response to reject immediately, accepting the latency and compatibility implications for existing callers.

options.title: Defer to broader lifecycle PR
options.body: Treat #39248 as blocked on the broader #58776/#77415 lifecycle design and keep this issue as the sandbox-specific proof case.

recommendation.title: Terminalize async startup failure
recommendation.body: Keep the accepted async spawn contract, but emit/log a typed startup failure and prove registry/session UI callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent and broad history across subagent lifecycle, registry, sandbox, and gateway paths touched by the decision.
